signature: createCanvas(opts?: { position?, size?, cameraPosition?, cameraTarget?, label? }): SubCanvasHandle

params.name: opts.position
params.desc: 子画布在主视图的角落位置

params.name: opts.label
params.desc: 画布 title 属性 (hover 时显示)

returns: SubCanvasHandle (含 id / canvas / camera / controls / destroy())
code: const sub = ssp.viewerTool.createCanvas({ position: 'top-right', size: { width: 320, height: 240 }, cameraPosition: { x: 0, y: 100, z: 80 } }); console.log('sub-canvas:', sub.id);
example: const sub = ssp.viewerTool.createCanvas({ position: 'bottom-left', label: '1 楼俯瞰', cameraPosition: { x: 0, y: 150, z: 0 }, cameraTarget: { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 } }); setTimeout(() => ssp.viewerTool.remove(sub.id), 30000);
guard: 子画布共享主 GLB 场景 (不重新加载)
子画布有独立相机 / controls / renderer
用 ssp.viewerTool.remove(id) 销毁子画布 (DOM + GPU)
子画布渲染同步主 rAF, 不会拖累主性能
